faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Jangaon District Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Jangaon District Recruitment 2026 is 14th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the eligibility criteria for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: For the Data Entry Operator post, candidates must possess any Degree along with a Diploma in Computer Applications (DCA) with MS-Office skills. This ensures proficiency in essential computer operations.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Jangaon District posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for all posts in the Jangaon District Recruitment 2026 is between 18 years and 46 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies for the Data Entry Operator post in the Jangaon District Recruitment 2026. This includes one vacancy for a Data Entry Operator and five for another Data Entry Operator role.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Data Entry Operator and Office Subordinate posts?
faq.answer: The Data Entry Operator posts offer a salary of Rs. 19500/- per month, while the Office Subordinate post offers Rs. 15600/- per month. These are attractive remuneration packages.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Jangaon District Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the Jangaon District Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Jangaon District Recruitment 2026. This makes the application process more accessible.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these government jobs?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Jangaon District Recruitment 2026 includes a Written Examination followed by the preparation of a Merit List. Candidates need to perform well in both stages.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to attach self-attested copies of necessary documents, including photograph, signature, ID proof, and educational certificates, along with the filled application form.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Jangaon District, which is https://jangaon.telangana.gov.in. The links are also provided in the Important Links section.
